projects.title: AI Legal Document Summarizer
projects.description: Built a legal document summarization platform ingesting Pdf/Docx files, implementing a RAG pipeline with FAISS. Integrated Google Gemini 2.5 Flash to generate three audience-specific summary levels (Executive, Standard, Detailed) with prompts, reducing manual case review time significantly. Implemented graceful RAG fallback mechanism to direct LLM inference ensuring zero user-facing failures during vector search errors. Exposed modular REST endpoints along with file validation, secure filename handling, and automatic cleanup of uploaded files post-processing to prevent sensitive legal data retention.
key_features: Generates three audience-specific summary levels (Executive, Standard, Detailed)
Exposes modular REST endpoints with file validation and secure filename handling
Automatic cleanup of uploaded files post-processing

projects.title: QuantumRecSys - Hybrid Quantum-Classical Movie Recommendation System
projects.description: Built a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Movie Recommender on MovieLens 1M, combining Variational QPCA, and TF-IDF filtering. Implemented a 5-qubit variational quantum circuit validated on IBM Kingston 156-qubit Heron r2 processor, achieving +44.1% Precision@10 over classical baseline. Outperformed +89.1% R@10 by fusing quantum, collaborative, and content-based scores. Deployed full-stack Streamlit app with tmdb API, user auth, watchlist, and three-model comparison dashboard.
key_features: Combines Variational QPCA and TF-IDF filtering
Validated on IBM Kingston 156-qubit Heron r2 processor
Outperformed +89.1% R@10 by fusing quantum, collaborative, and content-based scores
Deployed full-stack Streamlit app with user auth, watchlist, and three-model comparison dashboard

projects.title: AI-Powered Article Scraper & Enhancer
projects.description: Implemented a 3-phase full-stack MERN pipeline: scraping articles via Puppeteer/Cheerio, storing in MongoDB Atlas with duplicate detection, and enhancing content through Groq LLM API. Built RESTful Node.js/Express backend handling scrape triggers, AI enhancement endpoints, and structured metadata storage (title, author, URL, content) with mongoose schemas. Integrated Groq LLM API to autonomously rewrite and enhance scraped articles, storing AI-generated versions linked to their originals in MongoDB. Developed a responsive React frontend with Tailwind CSS to display side-by-side original and AI-enhanced articles fetched via axios from the backend API.
key_features: Stores data in MongoDB Atlas with duplicate detection
Enhances content through Groq LLM API
RESTful Node.js/Express backend with structured metadata storage
Responsive React frontend displaying side-by-side original and AI-enhanced articles
